geometry_descriptors.claim_limit: geometric descriptors only; no propulsion performance prediction
geometry_descriptors.magnet_density_basis: density_kg_per_m3 from the geometry material definition; assumed, not a selected or measured SmCo grade
manufacturability_warnings: Material properties include screening assumptions and require grade-specific thermal, structural, and magnetic qualification.

evidence.identity_basis: sweep-v2 case rebuilt by the wall-loss geometry screening pipeline; geometry/source/config/case hashes equal the sealed raw record; QoIs replay within the sweep-v2 tolerances

held_out.statement: sealed sweep-v2 QoIs replay within the sweep-v2 tolerances AND every sealed axis null inside the v3 window matches a v3 null (bijection)

not_applicable.cpu_cuda_parity: the campaign is CPU-only (no CUDA solve to compare); replaced by the determinism_replay gate (bitwise CPU re-solve)
